worldFact.fact: Baldwin Street in Dunedin holds the official Guinness World Record as the steepest residential street on Earth, climbing at an extreme maximum gradient of 34.8%. City builders paved its upper slopes in ribbed concrete because bitumen asphalt would melt and slide downhill during summer.
